seoTitle: How to Set Up Stripe Test Mode (2026 Guide)
metaDescription: Enable Stripe Test Mode, find your test API keys, and use Stripe's test cards to simulate payments before your store goes live.
intro: Test Mode is what lets you try out your Stripe checkout without risking real money, and it's worth knowing well before you launch anything. This guide covers enabling Test Mode in your dashboard, locating your test API keys, generating sample payments with Stripe's test cards, and switching between Live and Test Mode when you need to.

steps.heading: Enable Test Mode in your account
steps.body: Test Mode is a toggle inside your Stripe dashboard that switches your account into a safe simulation environment separate from real transactions.

steps.heading: Find your Test API keys
steps.body: Once Test Mode is active, Stripe provides a separate set of API keys meant only for testing, distinct from your live keys.

steps.heading: Use Stripe's test cards for payments
steps.body: Stripe publishes a set of test card numbers you can use to simulate successful payments, declines, and other scenarios without spending real money.

steps.heading: Switch between Live and Test Mode
steps.body: When you're ready to accept real payments, you can toggle back to Live Mode, keeping your test and live data completely separate.

faq.question: Does Test Mode use real money?
faq.answer: No, Test Mode simulates transactions using test card numbers so you can confirm your checkout works without spending real money.

faq.question: Are Test Mode API keys different from Live Mode keys?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe provides a separate set of Test API keys that only work in Test Mode, keeping test activity isolated from your live account.

faq.question: Who should use Stripe Test Mode?
faq.answer: Anyone running an online store or using Stripe as a payment processor should use Test Mode to troubleshoot and prepare before going live.

faq.question: Can I switch back and forth between Test and Live Mode?
faq.answer: Yes, Stripe lets you toggle between the two modes at any time from your dashboard.
